q: A buyer wants a carbon figure on every invoice line. How do I do that?
title: Carbon on every invoice line
short: Work out kg CO2e per unit for each product once, from your yearly Scope 1 and 2 and the inputs each product uses, then multiply by the quantity on each line. Update the per-unit figure when your inventory changes, and state the period and method on the invoice.
audience: Suppliers whose buyers ask for carbon per shipment

ol: Build a yearly per-unit figure per product, with a stated allocation rule.
Store it as a product attribute in your billing system.
Print quantity x per-unit figure on each line, with the basis year.

ul: Do not recalculate per invoice from that month's bills; seasonal swings confuse buyers.
Say whether the figure is cradle to gate.
Keep the workings ready for review.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol standards, including the Product Standard
